label: M1 presence scan reads no keyframes
old:
if (!keyframes.includes(name))
				return `Shipped component ${row.component} is missing keyframes ${name}`
new:
if (!keyframes.includes(name) && name === '')
				return `Shipped component ${row.component} is missing keyframes ${name}`

label: M2 collectAdditions passes over an unattributed keyframe
old:
if (component === undefined)
			throw new Error(`Keyframes ${name} answers to no shipped component`)

label: M3 digests written into an ordinary object
M4 priorities keyed without the condition
M6 feature spacing left as the sheet writes it
M8 inventory reader returns no media
old: return { version: inventory.version, digests, components, media }
new: return { version: inventory.version, digests, components, media: [] }
